thread:
oncall-bot: ALERT CLOSED: RWINF-504 — routing spike -> mitigation applied (autoscaler tweak + temporary model fallback). Incident duration ~47m. Filing PIR thread to collect timeline, impact, and action items. Please coordinate below.

samir: Thanks. Root cause looks like a confluence of sudden traffic skew + a bad routing rule that sent small percentage of traffic to a heavier model variant. Customer-visible 5xxs for ~3 customers (Acme Corp main). We should run the PIR within 72h. Who can facilitate? I can if no one else, but would prefer someone to take notes.

maria: I can facilitate if someone else takes notes. I have a packed Friday but can run a canary-style walkthrough: timeline, mitigations, actions.

aj: I'll take notes. Also I'll prepare the timeline snippet from logs (will pull KV cache metrics + routing decisions).

kim: Support - please include Acme support rep in attendee list. They want an exec summary. I can invite them.

elaine: I'm the infra owner for routing; I can run the RCA deep-dive. Not available Thursday morning PT; otherwise fine.

samir: Proposal: two slots (pick one)
- Option A: Thu 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PT
- Option B: Fri 2026-03-20 20:00 UTC / 13:00 PT
Please respond with A/B or "can't make". We need facilitator, note-taker, infra, oncall, support, and product rep.

maria: A works for me (facilitator).

aj: I can do notes for A.

elaine: A is ok too.

samir: kim - can you confirm Acme rep availability for A? Also we'll need the exec summary emailed by EOD Wed so they have context.

kim: Confirmed Acme rep can do A. Will send pre-read to them and product.

ops-bot: Reminder: add PIR to calendar with #incidents channel conference bridge + record notes to the incident doc at https://internal.redwood/docs/incidents/RWINF-504.

samir: Agenda (short):
```
1) Quick impact summary (2m) - kim
2) Timeline (10m) - aj
3) Mitigations applied & why (8m) - samir / infra
4) Root-cause hypotheses and data gaps (15m) - elaine / aj
5) Action items + owners (10m) - facilitator/maria
6) Exec summary and next steps (5m)
```

maria: Action item proposals before the PIR (so we don't lose time):
- A1: Ensure routing rule rollback guard added to canary pipeline (owner: elaine)
- A2: Add alert for model-variant skew > 10% in last 1m (owner: samir)
- A3: Run an automated replay for Acme traffic from 2026-03-18T09:30Z to verify token-level failures (owner: aj)
- A4: Draft exec summary (owner: kim)
Please flag if anything missing or if you want to reassign.

aj: I'll sketch the timeline + attach log extracts to the doc before the meeting. Expect a short query and a couple of sample traces.

elaine: A1 ack. I'll push a guard and open PR today; ETA EOD.

samir: A2 I can add a temporary alert and then follow up with Optimize to propose a permanent metric hook.

kim: A4 I will draft and circulate by Wed EOD.

maria: Who will own the issue tracker for follow-ups after PIR? I'd prefer a single source of truth issue per action with owners + due dates.

samir: I'll create the follow-up epic in the incidents board and assign owners after we finalize in the PIR.

aj: Note: please add any sequence numbers / log ids you want me to pull into the thread now so I can grab everything in one go.

maria: Can someone paste the temporary mitigation commands we ran (for the postmortem notes)?

samir: Pasting the commands we used to bump autoscaler / fallback:```
# bump pool size for variant-heavy workload
redwood infra scale --pool routing-heavy --count 8 --reason "RWINF-504 mitigation"
# enforce model fallback for 5% of traffic to l1-quantized
redwood route update --policy fallback --percent 5 --variant l1-quantized
```

kim: I'll add customer impact details (times + affected orgs) to the doc.

ops-bot: Note created: incidents/RWINF-504/pir-draft (assigned: aj temporarily).

maria: Great. If A gets majority yes, I'll create the calendar invite and include the doc link and the pre-read checklist. If anyone can't make A, reply here with "can't make A" and propose local times.

elaine: A yes.

aj: A yes.

samir: A yes.

kim: A yes.

maria: All right — slot A confirmed. I'll send invite + add Acme rep + product. Facilitator: me. Note-taker: aj. Please add anything you want in the pre-read by EOD Wed. :thumbsup:

samir: Thanks everyone. After the PIR we'll convert action items into the incident epic and set due dates. If anyone needs a pre-brief 1:1 before the PIR, ping me.

aj: I'll upload the sample traces and a short query to the doc shortly.

maria: Closing thread for now — calendar invite sent. :calendar:
